<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series (M, M+1, M+2, …) with intensities decreasing roughly by a factor of ~10 each step, the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution and does not show the characteristic 1:0.5 or 3:1 ratios of Cl, Br, S, etc. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
